authorisation: The Product Owner's mission of 2026-10-26 pre-authorized implementation, safe reversible migrations, tests, deployment to PRE-LIVE 172.21.60.25 and the protected merge of the exact verified head. It authorises no PMS, routing or network change by the agent, no deletion of PMS history, no PMS posting and no Go-Live.
root_causes: Portal Settings listed every network: its design dialog read the unfiltered network list, so archived, replaced and switched-off networks looked like active choices (the Client Wi-Fi site had seven archived networks beside its one serving network). Each screen read 'enabled' or 'archived' for itself; there was no single reading.

Rooms were shown and keyed by room number alone in several places (reconciliation tables, the sessions 'rooms' count), the same number at two PMS connections looked like one room, and the stays page had no way to look at one connection.

A PMS connection could not be removed at all: DECOMMISSIONED existed but was not reachable, revisions and secrets are immutable, and nothing told the administrator whether a connection was a never-used shell or history.

A network replacement carried addressing, reservations, routing and policy but not the network's sign-in narrowing or portal design, so a replaced network could offer methods its administrator had switched off.

The 'Change VLAN or port' dialog opened on the opposite topology to the network's own, and the screens equated a trunk with tagged VLANs, hiding that a native network and tagged VLANs can share one trunk port.
